name: fuel-pass
note: T284 (ADR 0063): a synthetic road network at no real place (open sea at 0 N 0 E), where least time and least fuel differ. Two towns 12 km apart, a straight secondary road over a 400 m pass between them (65 km/h, about 11 min) and a primary road round through the flat valley (75 km/h, about 17 km, 14 min). Least time takes the pass; least fuel the valley. devtool route --fixture devtool/fixtures/fuel-pass.json --drive <label> --prefer time|fuel|quick.
